editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood diner where the service feels like family, the food is genuinely delicious, and breakfast is an institution.
editorial.insiderTip: Go early on weekend brunch to avoid the line, or stop by on a weekday when you can chat with the servers—Liz and Brandy are part of what makes this place special.

topDishes.note: Reviewers called them dangerous—in the best way
Particularly praised for quality and value
